headline: This law names an FBI building in Vienna, Virginia, after Michael D. Resnick, the Terrorist Screening Center.
what_it_does: It officially designates the FBI building at 801 Follin Lane in Vienna, Virginia, as the "Michael D. Resnick Terrorist Screening Center." The law changes only the building's name and does not create new duties, programs, or funding. It is a ceremonial measure.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
